verses.original: אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ כְּדַבֵּ֤ר רְתֵ֔ת ה֖וּא נָשָׂ֥א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֶּאְשַׁ֥ם בַּבַּ֖עַל וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim kə·ḏab·bêr rə·ṯêṯ hū nā·śā bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·ye’·šam bab·ba·‘al way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: When Ephraim spoke there was trembling he was exalted in Israel But he incurred guilt through Baal and he died

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ לַחֲטֹ֗א יוֹסִ֣פוּ וַיַּעְשׂ֣וּ לָהֶם֩ מַסֵּכָ֨ה עֲצַבִּ֔ים כִּתְבוּנָם֙ מִכַּסְפָּ֤ם כֻּלֹּ֑ה לָהֶם֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָשִׁ֖ים הֵ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים זֹבְחֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם יִשָּׁקֽוּן׃ עֲגָלִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh la·ḥă·ṭō yō·w·si·p̄ū way·ya‘·śū lā·hem mas·sê·ḵāh ‘ă·ṣab·bîm kiṯ·ḇū·nām mik·kas·pām kul·lōh lā·hem ma·‘ă·śêh ḥā·rā·šîm hêm ’ō·mə·rîm zō·ḇə·ḥê ’ā·ḏām yiš·šā·qūn ‘ă·ḡā·lîm
verses.literal: Now they sin more and more and make for themselves cast images idols skillfully made from their silver all of them the work of craftsmen People say of them They offer human sacrifice . . . [and] kiss the calves

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יִֽהְיוּ֙ בֹּ֔קֶר כַּעֲנַן־ מַשְׁכִּ֣ים וְכַטַּ֖ל הֹלֵ֑ךְ כְּמֹץ֙ יְסֹעֵ֣ר מִגֹּ֔רֶן וּכְעָשָׁ֖ן מֵאֲרֻבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yih·yū bō·qer ka·‘ă·nan- maš·kîm wə·ḵaṭ·ṭal hō·lêḵ kə·mōṣ yə·sō·‘êr mig·gō·ren ū·ḵə·‘ā·šān mê·’ă·rub·bāh
verses.literal: Therefore they will be like the morning mist like the early dew that vanishes like chaff blown from a threshing floor like smoke through an open window

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם תֵדָ֔ע לֹ֣א וֵאלֹהִ֤ים זֽוּלָתִי֙ אַ֖יִן וּמוֹשִׁ֥יעַ בִּלְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ṯê·ḏā‘ lō wê·lō·hîm zū·lā·ṯî ’a·yin ū·mō·wō·šî·a‘ bil·tî
verses.literal: Yet I [am] the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt you know no God but Me for [there is] no Savior besides Me
I knew you in the wilderness in the land of drought

verses.original: כְּמַרְעִיתָם֙ וַיִּשְׂבָּ֔עוּ שָׂבְע֖וּ לִבָּ֑ם וַיָּ֣רָם עַל־ כֵּ֖ן שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mar·‘î·ṯām way·yiś·bā·‘ū śā·ḇə·‘ū lib·bām way·yā·rām ‘al- kên šə·ḵê·ḥū·nî
verses.literal: When they had pasture they became satisfied when they were satisfied their hearts became proud and as a result . . . they forgot Me

verses.original: כְּמוֹ־ שָׁ֑חַל וָאֱהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם כְּנָמֵ֖ר אָשֽׁוּר׃ עַל־ דֶּ֥רֶךְ
verses.transliteration: kə·mōw- šā·ḥal wā·’ĕ·hî lā·hem kə·nā·mêr ’ā·šūr ‘al- de·reḵ
verses.literal: So like a lion I will pounce on them like a leopard I will lurk by the path

verses.original: כְּדֹ֣ב שַׁכּ֔וּל אֶפְגְּשֵׁם֙ וְאֶקְרַ֖ע סְג֣וֹר לִבָּ֑ם שָׁם֙ וְאֹכְלֵ֥ם כְּלָבִ֔יא הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה חַיַּ֥ת תְּבַקְּעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḏōḇ šak·kūl ’ep̄·gə·šêm wə·’eq·ra‘ sə·ḡō·wr lib·bām šām wə·’ō·ḵə·lêm kə·lā·ḇî haś·śā·ḏeh ḥay·yaṯ tə·ḇaq·qə·‘êm
verses.literal: Like a bear robbed of her cubs I will attack them and I will tear open their chests . . . There I will devour them like a lion like a wild beast tearing them apart
You are destroyed O Israel because you are against Me against your helper

verses.original: אֱהִ֤י מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֵפ֔וֹא וְיוֹשִֽׁיעֲךָ֖ בְּכָל־ עָרֶ֑יךָ וְשֹׁ֣פְטֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ תְּנָה־ לִּ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ וְשָׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·hî mal·kə·ḵā ’ê·p̄ō·w wə·yō·wō·šî·‘ă·ḵā bə·ḵāl ‘ā·re·ḵā wə·šō·p̄ə·ṭe·ḵā ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tā tə·nāh- lî me·leḵ wə·śā·rîm
verses.literal: Where is your king now to save you in all your cities and the rulers to whom you said Give me a king and princes

verses.original: בְּאַפִּ֔י אֶֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֥ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּעֶבְרָתִֽי׃ס וְאֶקַּ֖ח
verses.literal: So in My anger I gave you a king and in My wrath I took [him] away
The iniquity of Ephraim [is] bound up his sin [is] stored up

verses.original: יֽוֹלֵדָ֖ה חֶבְלֵ֥י יָבֹ֣אוּ ל֑וֹ הוּא־ לֹ֣א חָכָ֔ם בֵן֙ כִּֽי־ עֵ֥ת בָּנִֽים׃ לֹֽא־ יַעֲמֹ֖ד בְּמִשְׁבַּ֥ר
verses.transliteration: yō·w·lê·ḏāh ḥeḇ·lê yā·ḇō·’ū lōw hū- lō ḥā·ḵām ḇên kî- ‘êṯ bā·nîm lō- ya·‘ă·mōḏ bə·miš·bar
verses.literal: Labor pains come upon him but he is vvv an unwise son When the time arrives he fails to present himself at the opening of the womb

verses.original: אֶפְדֵּ֔ם מִיַּ֤ד שְׁאוֹל֙ אֶגְאָלֵ֑ם מִמָּ֖וֶת אֱהִ֨י מָ֗וֶת דְבָרֶיךָ֜ אֱהִ֤י שְׁא֔וֹל קָֽטָבְךָ֙ נֹ֖חַם יִסָּתֵ֥ר מֵעֵינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·dêm mî·yaḏ šə·’ō·wl ’eḡ·’ā·lêm mim·mā·weṯ ’ĕ·hî mā·weṯ ḏə·ḇå̄·rɛ·ḵå̄ ’ĕ·hî šə·’ō·wl qā·ṭā·ḇə·ḵā nō·ḥam yis·sā·ṯêr mê·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol I will redeem them from Death Where O Death are your plagues Where O Sheol is your sting Compassion is hidden from My eyes

verses.original: כִּ֣י ה֔וּא יַפְרִ֑יא בֵּ֥ן אַחִ֖ים קָדִים֩ יָב֣וֹא ר֨וּחַ יְהוָ֜ה עֹלֶ֗ה מִמִּדְבָּ֣ר מְקוֹרוֹ֙ וְיֵב֤וֹשׁ מַעְיָנ֔וֹ וְיֶחֱרַ֣ב ה֣וּא יִשְׁסֶ֔ה אוֹצַ֖ר כָּל־ חֶמְדָּֽה׃ כְּלִ֥י
verses.transliteration: kî hū yap̄·rî bēn ’a·ḥîm qā·ḏîm yā·ḇō·w rū·aḥ Yah·weh ‘ō·leh mim·miḏ·bār mə·qō·w·rōw wə·yê·ḇō·wōš ma‘·yā·nōw wə·ye·ḥĕ·raḇ hū yiš·seh ’ō·w·ṣar kāl- ḥem·dāh kə·lî
verses.literal: Although he flourishes among his brothers an east wind will come a wind from the LORD rising up from the desert His fountain will fail and his spring will run dry The wind will plunder his treasury of every precious article

verses.original: שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן תֶּאְשַׁם֙ כִּ֥י מָרְתָ֖ה בֵּֽאלֹהֶ֑יהָ יִפֹּ֔לוּ בַּחֶ֣רֶב עֹלְלֵיהֶ֣ם יְרֻטָּ֔שׁוּ וְהָרִיּוֹתָ֖יו יְבֻקָּֽעוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: šō·mə·rō·wn te’·šam kî mā·rə·ṯāh bê·lō·he·hā yip·pō·lū ba·ḥe·reḇ ‘ō·lə·lê·hem yə·ruṭ·ṭā·šū wə·hā·rî·yō·w·ṯāw yə·ḇuq·qā·‘ū
verses.literal: Samaria will bear her guilt because she has rebelled against her God They will fall by the sword their little ones will be dashed to pieces and their pregnant women ripped open
